messages:
Alice M.: heads-up — after yesterday's RBAC tweak I’m seeing ~120 users in prod lose access to the analytics feature. staging looks fine. SCIM syncs from staging -> prod return 200 but group membership is empty in prod :confused:

Jamal R.: can you paste a sample user payload from the scim logs? are we filtering on externalId vs id? did anyone rotate the KMS key used for SCIM secret decryption last night? :eyes:

Alice M.: snippet from scim logs for alice@example.com:
```
2026-03-19T20:45:03Z INFO scim.request id=rc-9a3 user=alice@example.com method=PATCH status=200 body={"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[]}]}
```
The request shows success but members=[] which is wrong — upstream had groups.

audit-bot: KMS key alias arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:alias/scim-secrets rotated by infra:deploy at 2026-03-19T02:07:12Z

deploy-bot: canary rollout of rbacy-backfill started (canary=5%)

Sarah L.: two possibilities that fit: 1) attribute mapping changed so SCIM is sending groupExternalId rather than group id and prod mapping expects id; 2) decrypt failure caused the provisioner to no-op and surface 200 with empty members. check scim reconciler logs for "Unable to decrypt" or for attribute mapping tag names.

Jamal R.: looking at reconciler logs now — found this line repeated for the timeframe when users dropped:
```
2026-03-19T02:07:15Z ERROR reconciler.encryption decrypt-failed key=alias/scim-secrets err=AccessDeniedException
2026-03-19T02:07:15Z WARN reconciler.provisioning skipping-apply user=alice@example.com reason="decryption failed"
```
So the KMS rotation removed the old key alias temporarily and the reconciler fell back to a no-op path that still returned 200.

Alice M.: ugh. so requests succeeded but membership never applied. why staging unaffected?

Jamal R.: staging uses a different KMS alias (scim-secrets-staging) — that one wasn't rotated. Prod briefly lost access to the key alias during rotation window due to our IAM propagation timing. The reconciler code should have retried or raised error instead of skipping.

Sarah L.: mitigation steps: 1) rebind alias to previous key material to restore decrypt parity — done by infra if still available. 2) run a scim backfill for the affected orgs so groups are re-applied. 3) add a reconciler change to fail-fast on decrypt errors (so we see errors and alert). 4) add a canary and throttle window for future kms rotations.

Jamal R.: I've asked infra to rebind alias; they confirmed alias reassociated at 2026-03-19T03:01:02Z. Planning backfill now. Dry-run first:
```bash
scim-cli reconcile --org redwood-corp --since "2026-03-19T00:00:00Z" --dry-run
```

Alice M.: please include a filter for users that lost analytics entitlement — we want to avoid touching unrelated accounts.

Jamal R.: will do. found ~123 affected accounts in dry run. Next step apply in small batches:
```bash
scim-cli reconcile --org redwood-corp --since "2026-03-19T00:00:00Z" --apply --batch-size 50
```
Schedule starting in 30m to give ops time to monitor.

deploy-bot: rbacy-backfill canary completed (5% -> healthy), scheduling next wave.

Sarah L.: followups / docs: - add a pre-rotation checklist for KMS alias handover (verify IAM propagation, reconcile dry-run) - change reconciler behavior: log and surface decrypt failures to PagerDuty instead of returning success - add an end-to-end integration test that simulates key rotation and verifies group application

Alice M.: agree. also update audit log retention for SCIM diffs — we need at least 7 days to safely reconcile after latent rotations.

Jamal R.: assigning actions: infra to own alias handover improvements (Jamal assigned infra ticket #INF-432), reconciler team to open PR for fail-fast + PD (Sarah), product to confirm entitlement backfill scope (Alice). Oncall: Jamal.

Alice M.: thanks all — monitoring backfill now. will post once the 1st batch completes. :thumbsup:
